related.title: 星鏈與低軌通訊星系
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：僅在總量、包絡、質心與固定需求皆通過時接受配置，不能靠壓縮安全間隙增載。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept a layout only after totals, envelopes, center of mass and restraint needs pass; do not remove required clearances to gain load. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 拆解往返延遲，區分幾何下界與實測服務延遲。
related.differenceEn: Decompose round-trip latency and distinguish a geometric floor from measured service latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成可用體積 20 m³、包裝密度 120 kg/m³、質量限制 3000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：體積限制質量=20×120=2400 kg，小於 3000 kg。 結果約 2400 kg。質量上限=min(允許質量,可用體積×包裝密度)；包裝密度不是材料密度。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成高度 550 km、光速 300000 km/s、額外處理與排隊往返 12 ms。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：RTT=4×550/300000×1000+12。 結果約 19.3333 ms。教學兩段上／下行各 h，往返光程=4h；加處理排隊時間。真實斜距與路由通常更長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic usable volume is 20 m³, packed density 120 kg/m³ and mass allowance 3000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Volume-limited mass=20×120=2400 kg, below 3000 kg. Result ≈ 2400 kg. Cargo limit=min(mass allowance, usable volume×packed density); packed density differs from material density.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic altitude is 550 km, light speed 300000 km/s and extra round-trip processing/queueing 12 ms. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: RTT=4×550/300000×1000+12. Result ≈ 19.3333 ms. For two vertical legs each h, round-trip path=4h; add processing/queue delay. Real slant ranges and routing are generally longer.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 太空儀器熱真空試驗
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：僅在總量、包絡、質心與固定需求皆通過時接受配置，不能靠壓縮安全間隙增載。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept a layout only after totals, envelopes, center of mass and restraint needs pass; do not remove required clearances to gain load. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 估算熱平衡等待時間，區分箱壁達溫與試件達穩態。
related.differenceEn: Estimate thermal settling time and distinguish chamber-wall temperature from article equilibrium.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成可用體積 20 m³、包裝密度 120 kg/m³、質量限制 3000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：體積限制質量=20×120=2400 kg，小於 3000 kg。 結果約 2400 kg。質量上限=min(允許質量,可用體積×包裝密度)；包裝密度不是材料密度。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學初溫 40°C、環境 −20°C、時間常數 1800 s，等待 3600 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：T=−20+60exp(−3600/1800)。 結果約 -11.8799 °C。集中熱容量模型 T=Tenv+(T0−Tenv)e^(−t/τ)；假設單一時間常數、固定環境及無自熱。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic usable volume is 20 m³, packed density 120 kg/m³ and mass allowance 3000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Volume-limited mass=20×120=2400 kg, below 3000 kg. Result ≈ 2400 kg. Cargo limit=min(mass allowance, usable volume×packed density); packed density differs from material density.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching initial temperature is 40°C, environment −20°C, time constant 1800 s and wait 3600 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: T=−20+60exp(−3600/1800). Result ≈ -11.8799 °C. The lumped model T=Tenv+(T0−Tenv)e^(−t/τ) assumes one time constant, fixed surroundings and no self-heating.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
